title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Crew Scope of Work
content:
On a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment, what the crew does at the address is fixed by the service level booked.

## Scope clauses

1. On the delivery date the crew, of the service level's crew size, takes the merchandise to the service level's placement location.
2. Where the service level requires a customer's presence, an adult must be at the address throughout the window, and a crew finding nobody logs customer not home.
3. The crew unpacks only where the level includes unpacking, assembles only where it includes assembly, and removes packaging only where it includes packaging removal.
4. Installation is limited to the level's appliance installation types where the level includes installation labor. Gas appliances, built-in or cabinet-modified installations, new water, gas or electrical lines and permits are never performed.
5. The appliance being replaced is disconnected only where the level includes disconnection of the old appliance.
6. A television is wall-mounted only up to the level's largest screen size and only on the wall constructions the level supports. Masonry, plaster and metal-stud walls and above-fireplace mounts are declined at the door without a fee.
7. A completed appointment fulfills its purchase on the completion date when the purchase is still placed.

## Scope questions

**Does any level install a gas dryer?** No. Gas appliances are never performed.

**Will the crew run a new water line for a refrigerator?** No. New water, gas or electrical lines are never performed.

**What happens to a mount on a brick wall?** Masonry is declined at the door, without a fee.

**When is the purchase marked fulfilled?** On the completion date of a completed appointment, when the purchase is still placed.
